clean.tx: Thíshti xtáwithe. Shi thíshti xtóⁿthathe. éshti xtóⁿthai ge shi wíshti xtáathe.
clean.tl: I like you. And you like me. S/he likes me and I like her/him too.

clean.tx: Zhiⁿgá ama águdishti údon wánoⁿʔoⁿnoⁿ, shi águdishti wánoⁿʔoⁿbazhinoⁿ.
clean.tl: Some of the children are good; they listen to us, but some of them don't listen to us.

clean.tx: Shi umóⁿhoⁿ ti thoⁿ shti agíwahoⁿ.
clean.tl: And I (will) pray for my Omaha camp/village.' (i.e. for the present-day reservation)

clean.tx: Shi tʰóⁿwoⁿgtha dúba édi moⁿthíⁿ umóⁿhoⁿ shti ewéwaha.
clean.tl: And I (will) pray for the Omaha who are in various cities.' (i.e. off reservation)
And for the path we will take.' (i.e. for our lives)
I will pray for those things.

clean.tx: Iⁿnoⁿha akʰá, iⁿdadi éthoⁿba théthudi gthíⁿ éshti.
clean.tl: My mom and also my dad, they live here too.
Ivan and Silas, those two were brothers.

clean.tx: Ithádi, ihóⁿ akʰa shti gínita ezhé goⁿkí ithádi ama, ihóⁿ akʰá zhúgigthabazhí.
clean.tl: His father and his mother are both alive, but his father and mother do not live together.

clean.tx: Tim akʰá iwíkoⁿtaakʰa Clifford shti utháha uwíkoⁿta
clean.tl: Tim will help me and Clifford.

clean.tx: Umóⁿhoⁿ kʰe shaóⁿ kʰe shi wóⁿdoⁿ kikínanoⁿi
clean.tl: The Omaha and the Sioux tribes used to fight each other.
